services.desc: Duration 3 or 4 Hour Trip Rates (May increase on or near holidays) Starting at - $590 About Come and enjoy our fantastic MULTI-ACTIVITY boat charter with Sandbar plus add-on Snorkel or Sightsee. We provide coolers, ice, and water toys. The Captain provides a spectacular multi-activity adventure to include any or all of the amenities below, depending on weather and ocean conditions. A typical day includes boarding our guests at their given time, heading out the Hens and Chickens reef for an hour or so, then spending the remainder of the day at the Islamorada Sandbar (or Mangrove Islands on windy days). Optionally, if not snorkeling, we offer an easy cruise back to the dock on the bayside
